verdict.rationale: Fee transparency is a fair question for an immigration law firm, but the evidence pack shows no pricing pages. Nothing separates the firm's legal fees from USCIS filing fees or premium processing. The only cost-related evidence is a generic marketing claim of 'cost-effective' solutions and consultation booking, which does not show an itemized all-in cost.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
